rationale: Yesterday's collapse from 13.74 to 11.54 on ~7% of float left heavy trapped supply overhead, and today's bounce has already filled the gap, stalling right at the prior-day low zone (11.38) with descending micro-highs (11.80 → 11.67 → 11.58) and the heaviest 1m candle being a sell-off — a mild bearish tilt reinforced by the risk-off tape. However, price still holds well above session VWAP ($10.62) with a higher intraday low at 11.21, so the evidence is conflicting at mid-range. With a 43.7bps spread and first-15-minute volatility, a market entry here has near-zero expected value after costs; I'd only act on a decisive break of 11.20 (short) or a strong reclaim of 11.67 (long).
